newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes stronger on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes stronger on dollar supply.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka ended stronger at 42.5400/5430 to the dollar against its previous close of 42.5450/5460 after banks supplied a large amount of dollars in interbank trade ahead of year-end holidays, dealers said.
The local unit quoted firmer at 42.5400/5450 per dollar in early trade but edged up further with rising dollar supply.
"Some banks have got fresh supplies of wage earners' remmitance. Moreover, they are eager to retain taka during holidays because of higher interest return," said one dealer.
The call money was traded at 7.0 percent to 7.5 percent, down from previous 8.0-8.5 percent, dealers said.
